description: Non-atomic reportability contract (Sen24 M3) for the Percent/Trend Dafny minimal example. Retained-set convention: a lever means 'keep the original commitment'; deleting a lever applies its edit.

KEEP_DIRECT_PERCENT_CALL.kept_commitment: Trend body stays a direct Percent call
KEEP_DIRECT_PERCENT_CALL.edit_detail: Trend body direct call => guarded implementation (span<=0 returns 0)

block_map_properties.note: |beta(ORIGINAL_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_SURFACE)| = 2, so RepairAtomicity is false and ORIGINAL_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_SURFACE is non-atomic. This is an M3-B (non-atomic) case, NOT M3-A. Site-restricted candidate generation (A-only / B-only) is a separate policy and is NOT RepairAtomicity.
